text:
incident-bot: PAGER: Elevated 5xx rate detected for /v1/generate (gateway) — 12% error rate over 5m, latency spike. Impact: ~4% of requests failing. corr_ids: c4f2-9a1b, d7e3-8b2c.

oncall_ana: I'm on call, jumping in. tagging @sam_irving for gateway, @maria_ops for routing & fallbacks.

sam_irving: looking at edge metrics. seeing retry amplification from upstream pool (svc-inference-us). hitting 502s from upstreams around 11:14:22 UTC.

maria_ops: can we put a temporary route fallback to dedicated small model pool to reduce pressure?

ryan_sre: quick customer-impact check: CS reports 3 customers opened chat issues. @cs_engineer_liz can you confirm severity?

cs_engineer_liz: Customers A & B observed failures in prod, intermittent 502s, but no data loss. Classifying P2 for now, escalating if outages widen.

oncall_ana: mitigation plan: 1) throttle ingress retries 2) enable routing to fallback-pool v2 3) gather kvlogs and build timeline. I'll coordinate.

sam_irving: throttle applied at edge (no_retry header) for high QPS clients. pushing route rule now: route /v1/generate -> fallback-pool when gateway error rate > 5%.

incident-bot: ACTION: route-update deployed by maria_ops at 3159001260 — fallback routing enabled.

oncall_ana: collecting logs now. Sam, can you dump a short set of request logs for corr_id c4f2-9a1b and d7e3-8b2c? Use kvlog export.

sam_irving: exported snippet below (sanitized):

```
[11:14:22 UTC] corr=c4f2-9a1b req=/v1/generate upstream=svc-inference-us host=gateway-3 status=502 retries=3 latency=210ms error=upstream-reset
headers: x-retry-count=3, x-client=mobile
```

```
[11:14:23 UTC] corr=d7e3-8b2c req=/v1/generate upstream=svc-inference-us host=gateway-3 status=502 retries=2 latency=185ms error=timeout
```

sam_irving: uploading full kvlog bundle to dropbox: https://internal.drop/kvlogs/315900_kvlog_bundle.zip (sha256: abcd1234...)

maria_ops: timeline so far: 11:12 - backend pod restarts begin, 11:13 - small surge in retries, 11:14 - error rate >5%, 11:15 - fallback route enabled.

oncall_ana: hypotheses: A) upstream pool experiencing restart loop -> transient connection resets -> retry amplification. B) KG/serving runtime hitting resource exhaustion on certain models causing timeouts.

ryan_sre: quick checks: node metrics show OOM kills on node pool n-infer-5 at 11:12 for 2 pods. Probable hypothesis A + some degraded pods causing retries.

maria_ops: can we rollback the last model deploy to that pool? any deploys ~11:10?

sam_irving: deployment history: model-bundle v3.4 rolled at 11:05 to svc-inference-us. I recommend rollback to v3.3 if OOMs persist.

oncall_ana: action items (in-thread tracking):
- [x] throttle retries at edge (sam_irving)
- [x] enable fallback routing (maria_ops)
- [x] kvlog bundle uploaded (sam_irving)
- [ ] rollback model-bundle v3.4 (pending owner approval)
- [ ] gather full node kube logs for affected pods (ryan_sre)

cs_engineer_liz: notifying affected customers with brief status: mitigation in place, degraded but functional.

sam_irving: quick note: we've observed correlation pattern where clients with high retry aggressiveness (x-retry-count >=3) amplify failures — will surface as mitigation recommendation.

oncall_ana: last note for now — fallback routing cut error rate to ~1.8% and latency normalized after 11:20. We'll keep monitoring. Opening RCA thread after postmortem.

incident-bot: RESOLVED: incident marked mitigated at 3159001380 — error rate returned to baseline, further investigation to continue in rca channel.
